stem:
Rohan packs about $25$ boxes with about $12$ notebooks in each box for a school sale. An exact notebook count is not needed to order labels.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: Estimation means treating $25\times12$ as a finished notebook-by-notebook census of every notebook.
An estimate near $300$ notebooks is enough for ordering labels.
A reasonable estimate suits this purpose because an exact count is unnecessary here.
Exact counting is what produces estimates, so he must finish a full tally first.

teacher.key_rationale: 25×12≈300 is a fit estimate when exact counting is unnecessary. Treating estimate as census, or saying exact counting creates estimates, miss the purpose hinge.
